description: Use this when the user wants a consumer price index calculator, inflation rate calculator or cpi calculator across many years: a year-by-year table of the annual average CPI-U and the yearly inflation rate, with a CSV download. It uses the bundled published CPI-U series for 1913 through the latest full year, up to 120 years per call. Do not use for a single amount conversion (use adjust_for_inflation), for other countries, for monthly percent changes, or for forecasts.

end_year.description: The last year of the table, e.g. 2024. At most 120 years after the start year and not after the latest full year.

start_year.description: The first year of the table, e.g. 1990. 1913 or later.

name: inflation_table
title: Inflation table
